_meta.price_encoding: integer paisa (100 paisa = Rs 1); never a floating-point value
_meta.tax_note: All prices are TAX-INCLUSIVE. No code path may add tax on top of a menu price.
_meta.image_convention: image_path is empty because no artwork ships with the project; drop files at assets/images/menu/<image_slug>.jpg and set image_path to use them.
_meta.compat_note: Each item repeats image_path/is_available as image/available so models::MenuItem::fromJson can read it unchanged.
